motion: Low Calorie foods are healthy option for adults in Late 60's

turns.argument_point: Low-calorie foods can help manage weight and reduce the risk of chronic diseases, such as diabetes and heart disease, which are common concerns for adults in their late 60s.
turns.rebuttal: While it is true that low-calorie foods can contribute to weight management and reduced risk of chronic diseases, one must also consider the potential drawbacks of an overly restrictive diet at this stage in life. For instance, a diet that is too low in calories may compromise muscle mass and bone density, which are already vulnerable in older adults.
